POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Vehicle body, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body.

2. When learning General workshop rules and regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations.

3. When learning Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

4. When learning Power Mechanics workshop layout, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Mechanics workshop layout.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

7. When learning Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

9. When learning Blending of lines and curves, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Blending of lines and curves.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending of lines and curves.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending of lines and curves.

10. When learning General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   B. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

11. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Evolution of motor vehicles and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Power Mechanics workshop layout and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.

3. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Mechanics workshop layout.

5. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. C — CPU

7. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.

8. A — Information and Communication Technology

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.

10. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

11. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Power Mechanics workshop layout; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
